description: This file contains implementation of the QuicStreamSequencerBufferPeer class, which provides testing utilities and invariants checking for QuicStreamSequencerBuffer in the QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: QuicStreamSequencerBufferPeer
classes.description: A testing peer class for QuicStreamSequencerBuffer, providing methods to inspect and verify internal invariants and state.

methods.name: QuicStreamSequencerBufferPeer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the peer with a pointer to QuicStreamSequencerBuffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer into a destination buffer, returning the number of bytes read.

methods.name: CheckEmptyInvariants
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is empty and all blocks are deallocated.

methods.name: IsBlockArrayEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the block array within the buffer is empty.

methods.name: CheckInitialState
methods.description: Verifies initial state invariants of the buffer.

methods.name: CheckBufferInvariants
methods.description: Checks various invariants of the buffer's internal state.

methods.name: GetInBlockOffset
methods.description: Returns the in-block offset for a given stream offset.

methods.name: GetBlock
methods.description: Returns a specific block pointer from the buffer.

methods.name: IntervalSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the interval of received bytes.

methods.name: max_buffer_capacity
methods.description: Returns the maximum buffer capacity in bytes.

methods.name: ReadableBytes
methods.description: Returns the number of readable bytes in the buffer.

methods.name: set_total_bytes_read
methods.description: Sets the total bytes read in the buffer.

methods.name: AddBytesReceived
methods.description: Adds a range of received bytes to the buffer's tracking set.

methods.name: IsBufferAllocated
methods.description: Checks if the buffer's blocks are allocated.

methods.name: max_blocks_count
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of blocks.

methods.name: current_blocks_count
methods.description: Returns the current number of blocks.

methods.name: bytes_received
methods.description: Returns the set of received byte intervals.
